message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. Facts: The defendant operated a food processing company, produced pickled vegetables, added salt product labeled “湖北高级精制盐” with standard GB/T5462. The salt had zero iodine content, while in iodine-deficient areas must use iodized salt. So they used non-iodized salt but labeled as iodized? Actually they added salt product with label indicating standard, but the salt had zero iodine. This is adulteration of food, false labeling, violating food safety. Under Chinese criminal law, offenses: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" (producing and selling food that does not meet safety standards). Also possibly "非法添加非食用盐" but main is food safety offense.

The correction rules: If facts describe acquisition, processing, sale of unsafe food, classify under food safety statutes (e.g., 生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品). So we output that offense.

We need to output only statutory offense name without appending “罪”. So just "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". Possibly also "非法添加非食用盐"? But the rule says list each specific fraud charge separately if multiple fraud categories. Not relevant. No forged seal. No self-surrender? The defense claims self-surrender, but that doesn't affect crime name.

Thus single crime: 生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品.
